## E01 — Public website and governed content

**Goal:** Explain VERITRAIL's framework, solutions, compliance position and industry guidance from one governed Markdown source that the Python platform and the React site share.

**Area:** Public website and content · **Status:** Live

**Capabilities:** CAP-001 Home page, CAP-002 Website content pages, CAP-074 Reading aids, CAP-075 Section illustrations and share images

### S01.1

**As a prospective buyer**, I want to read what VERITRAIL is, the problem it solves and how it works on the home page, so that I can decide quickly whether it fits my organisation.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given the home page, when it loads, then it shows the headline, two primary actions and counts of controls, pillars, layers and assessment questions taken from the content.
- Given the home Markdown changes shape, when a section no longer matches its layout, then the section still renders as plain Markdown.

**Routes:** `/` · **Capabilities:** CAP-001 · **Tests:** `site-pages.test.ts`, `site-reading.test.ts`

### S01.2

**As a prospective buyer**, I want to browse framework, solutions, compliance, industries, resources and legal pages from a menu, so that I can find the depth I need.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given any page, when I open the menu, then every section and its pages are listed, on desktop and phone.
- Given an internal link or call to action in any page, when followed, then it resolves to a page (no 404).

**Routes:** `/framework`, `/solutions`, `/compliance`, `/industries`, `/resources`, `/about` · **Capabilities:** CAP-002 · **Tests:** `site-pages.test.ts`, `app-routing.test.tsx`

### S01.3

**As a Chief Risk / Compliance Officer**, I want to read the compliance guides with clear limits on what VERITRAIL claims, so that I do not mistake readiness support for certification.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given a compliance page, when it loads, then the standard disclaimer is shown and mappings are described as indicative.
- Given the content checks, when run, then prohibited claims (certify, guarantee compliance) are not present.

**Routes:** `/compliance/eu-ai-act`, `/compliance/nist-ai-rmf`, `/compliance/iso-42001`, `/compliance/gap-analysis` · **Capabilities:** CAP-002 · **Tests:** `platform-content-checks.test.ts`

### S01.4

**As a prospective buyer**, I want long pages broken into scannable parts, so that I can read 1,000-word pages without losing my place.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given a page with three or more sections, when it loads, then an "On this page" list highlights the current section.
- Given bold-led lists, numbered steps, tables, code and FAQs, when rendered, then they appear as cards, timelines, stacked tables on phones, copyable code and accordions.
- Given a control ID or glossary term in text, when shown, then it links to its control or shows its definition.

**Routes:** `/solutions/shield` · **Capabilities:** CAP-002, CAP-073, CAP-074 · **Tests:** `site-reading.test.ts`

### S01.5

**As a prospective buyer**, I want to share a page and see a relevant preview card, so that colleagues know what I am sending them.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given a page in a section with a share image, when its head is rendered, then og:image and twitter:image are absolute URLs to that section's 1200×630 image.

**Capabilities:** CAP-075 · **Tests:** `site-reading.test.ts`

## E02 — Control library and framework mappings

**Goal:** Publish the 64 controls by pillar with owners, evidence and indicative NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and EU AI Act mappings.

**Area:** Public website and content · **Status:** Live

**Capabilities:** CAP-003 Control library, CAP-004 Control detail

### S02.1

**As an AI governance lead**, I want to see all controls grouped by pillar with objective, priority and scope, so that I can plan which controls matter first.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given the control library, when it loads, then all controls appear under their pillar with counts, a priority mosaic and pillar cards.
- Given a phone, when the control tables render, then each row stacks into a labelled card.

**Routes:** `/framework/controls` · **Capabilities:** CAP-003 · **Tests:** `site-pages.test.ts`

### S02.2

**As an internal auditor / assessor**, I want to open one control with its evidence examples and mappings, so that I know what an assessor expects to see.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given a control page, when it loads, then it shows owner, priority, scope, evidence examples, framework references, related questions and critical flags.
- Given a control page, when it loads, then the mosaic highlights where it sits in the library.

**Routes:** `/framework/controls/$controlId` · **Capabilities:** CAP-004 · **Tests:** `site-pages.test.ts`, `app-routing.test.tsx`

## E03 — Free assessment and triage tools

**Goal:** Give visitors useful, honest results in the browser — maturity, risk tier, guardrails and cited answers — that are labelled User-asserted or Inferred.

**Area:** Free interactive tools · **Status:** Live

**Capabilities:** CAP-010 Maturity self-assessment, CAP-011 Risk triage, CAP-012 Guardrail generator, CAP-013 Ask VERITRAIL

### S03.1

**As an AI governance lead**, I want to answer 24 questions and get an indicative maturity level by domain, so that I have a starting baseline in about 8 minutes.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given complete answers, when I finish, then I see the overall score, level (Initial to Optimized) and eight domain scores, all labelled User-asserted.
- Given the same answers, when scored, then the result matches the Python reference engine (parity fixtures).
- Given I leave mid-way, when I return in the same tab, then my answers are restored from session storage; contact details are never stored there.

**Routes:** `/tools/maturity-assessment` · **Capabilities:** CAP-010 · **Tests:** `site-assessment-engine.test.ts`

### S03.2

**As an AI governance lead**, I want to get the detailed report with strengths, gaps, critical flags and a 30/60/90-day plan, so that I can act on the result.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given the report gate, when I submit a business email with consent, then the lead is stored without my raw answers and the full report is shown.
- Given a free-mail address, when submitted, then it is refused with "Please use your business email address."
- Given the service is unreachable, when I submit, then the report is still shown and the page says nothing was saved or emailed.
- Given the report, when downloaded, then Markdown and PDF versions are available.

**Routes:** `/tools/maturity-assessment` · **Capabilities:** CAP-010, CAP-020 · **Tests:** `site-assessment-engine.test.ts`

### S03.3

**As an AI system owner**, I want to describe one AI use case and get a suggested risk tier with the reasons, so that I know how much assessment and approval it needs.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given the intake, when I submit, then I get Prohibited-review, High, Medium or Low with factor points, triggers, missing facts, approval authority and review cadence.
- Given three or more key facts are missing, when scored, then a Low result is raised to Medium.
- Given any result, when shown, then it is labelled Inferred and requires human confirmation.

**Routes:** `/tools/risk-triage` · **Capabilities:** CAP-011 · **Tests:** `site-risk-tier.test.ts`

Known gaps:

- No UI test for the triage form.

### S03.4

**As a CISO / security architect**, I want to describe an LLM app or agent and get a draft runtime policy and tool permission matrix, so that engineering has a concrete starting point.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given the app profile, when submitted, then I get a rating across autonomy, tool risk, data exposure and blast radius, a permission matrix, approval rules and limits.
- Given the draft policy, when downloaded (YAML, JSON, Markdown, PDF), then it is version 0.1.0, status draft and rollout observe — never active.

**Routes:** `/tools/guardrail-generator` · **Capabilities:** CAP-012 · **Tests:** `site-shield.test.ts`

Known gaps:

- No UI test for the generator form.

### S03.5

**As a prospective buyer**, I want to ask governance questions and get answers that cite controls, so that I can explore the framework conversationally.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given a question, when answered, then the answer cites VERITRAIL controls and is produced deterministically in the browser (no AI model, no network).
- Given a prompt-injection, approval-bypass or compliance-determination request, when asked, then it is refused with the reason.

**Routes:** `/tools/ask-veritrail` · **Capabilities:** CAP-013 · **Tests:** `site-ask-veritrail.test.ts`

## E04 — Lead capture and qualification

**Goal:** Capture enquiries and assessment leads safely, qualify them, and say plainly when nothing was recorded.

**Area:** Lead capture · **Status:** Live

**Capabilities:** CAP-020 Lead forms

### S04.1

**As a prospective buyer**, I want to book a Governance Baseline, request a demo, join the design partner programme or contact the team, so that I can start a conversation.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given a form, when I submit valid details with consent, then the submission is stored in site_leads through the submitLead server function.
- Given a network failure, when I submit, then the form says nothing was recorded.
- Given the hidden honeypot is filled, when submitted, then nothing is stored and the visitor sees the normal confirmation.

**Routes:** `/contact`, `/contact/book-governance-baseline`, `/contact/request-demo`, `/contact/design-partner-programme`, `/contact/newsletter` · **Capabilities:** CAP-020 · **Tests:** `platform-misc-parity.test.ts`

Known gaps:

- No direct test of LeadForm or the submitLead handler.
- submitLead has no rate limiting.
- No confirmation e-mails are sent (no SMTP on Workers).

### S04.2

**As a site administrator**, I want assessment leads tagged by qualification rules, so that sales can prioritise follow-up.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given an assessment lead, when stored, then its payload holds the score summary, profile, critical flags and lead tags from the template's lead rules.
- Given CRM environment variables, when a lead is stored, then it is pushed to the webhook or HubSpot; a CRM failure never fails the lead.

**Capabilities:** CAP-020, CAP-067 · **Tests:** `platform-misc-parity.test.ts`

### S04.3

**As a prospective buyer**, I want to download the Enterprise Blueprint, so that I have the operating model in one document.

*Status: Partial*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given the blueprint form, when submitted, then the download link is shown.

**Routes:** `/resources/blueprint` · **Capabilities:** CAP-020 · **Tests:** none yet

Known gaps:

- The PDF is a public static file
- so the form gate is cosmetic.

## E05 — TILLER assessment, scoring and release readiness

**Goal:** Score the six TILLER pillars against evidence, compute the VERITRAIL Index and gate releases by risk tier.

**Area:** Workspace — assessment and release readiness · **Status:** Live

**Capabilities:** CAP-030 Governance overview, CAP-031 TILLER assessment, CAP-032 Release readiness

### S05.1

**As an AI governance lead**, I want to score each of the 12 TILLER controls from 0 to 4 and record evidence status, so that the workspace reflects what is in place and what is proven.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given a score of 3 or more, when the evidence is not Verified, then the effective score is capped at 2 and the screen says so.
- Given I add an evidence URL or attachment, when saved, then the evidence status is at least Claimed.

**Routes:** `/assess` · **Capabilities:** CAP-031 · **Tests:** `governance.test.ts`

Known gaps:

- Evidence "Upload demo" stores a placeholder name only; no file storage.
- No UI test for the assessment screen.

### S05.2

**As an AI governance lead**, I want to see the VERITRAIL Index, maturity band and pillar scores on the overview, so that I can report the programme's position at a glance.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given answers, when the overview loads, then pillar scores, the index, the band and verified-evidence count are computed from the model.
- Given a top gap, when I choose "Add to roadmap", then it is added once to the roadmap.

**Routes:** `/workspace` · **Capabilities:** CAP-030 · **Tests:** `governance.test.ts`, `governance-provider.test.tsx`

### S05.3

**As an approver**, I want to see whether the workspace is Cleared, Conditional or Blocked for release at its risk tier, so that I approve with the right conditions.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given the tier floor (High 70, Medium 55, Low 40), when two or more release pillars are below it, then the gate is Blocked; one is Conditional; none is Cleared.
- Given blocking controls, when I choose "Create remediation plan", then each becomes a roadmap item.

**Routes:** `/gates` · **Capabilities:** CAP-032 · **Tests:** `governance.test.ts`

Known gaps:

- The gate is workspace-wide
- not per system.

### S07.1

**As a CISO / security architect**, I want to switch 21 guardrails on or off across seven groups and see required coverage for the tier, so that I know which runtime controls are missing.

## E08 — Operational governance registers

**Goal:** Run AI incidents, governance decisions, change reviews, monitoring and corrective actions with lifecycle rules and history.

**Area:** Workspace — operational governance · **Status:** Live

**Capabilities:** CAP-037 Incidents and near misses, CAP-038 Governance decisions, CAP-039 Change reviews, CAP-040 Monitoring, CAP-041 Corrective actions

### S08.1

**As an AI system owner**, I want to log an AI incident or near miss and move it through triage to closure, so that every incident has an owner and a history.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given an incident, when its status changes, then a timestamped history entry is added.
- Given the register, when filtered, then active, resolved and closed incidents can be separated.

**Routes:** `/incidents` · **Capabilities:** CAP-037 · **Tests:** `incidents.test.ts`, `incidents-ui.test.tsx`

### S08.2

**As an approver**, I want to record approvals, conditional approvals and time-bound risk acceptances per system, so that decisions have a rationale and a review date.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given Risk accepted or Conditional approval, when saved, then a review date on or after the decision date is required.
- Given a new decision for a system, when saved, then the previous current decision becomes Superseded.

**Routes:** `/decisions` · **Capabilities:** CAP-038 · **Tests:** `decision-schema.test.ts`, `evidence-export.test.ts`

Known gaps:

- Decisions cannot be edited or deleted.
- A decision does not change the system's inventory status.

### S08.3

**As an AI system owner**, I want to submit a material change with impact ratings for review, so that changes are screened before they ship.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given any impact rated High or Critical, when shown, then the review is flagged for escalation.
- Given any impact Not assessed, when a reviewer tries to approve, then approval is not allowed.

**Routes:** `/changes` · **Capabilities:** CAP-039 · **Tests:** `change-review.test.ts`, `checklist.test.ts`

Known gaps:

- A refused transition does nothing silently; the screen shows no error.

### S08.4

**As an engineering / platform lead**, I want to define monitoring plans with thresholds and record observations, so that breaches are visible and linked to incidents.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given an observation crossing the threshold, when recorded, then the plan shows Breach and links to the incident register.
- Given a cadence, when an observation is recorded, then the next due date moves on, clamped to month ends.

**Routes:** `/monitoring` · **Capabilities:** CAP-040 · **Tests:** `monitoring.test.ts`, `checklist.test.ts`

Known gaps:

- Observations are manual; there is no telemetry feed.
- Thresholds cannot be edited (pause and recreate).

### S08.5

**As an AI system owner**, I want to work a corrective action from start to verified closure, so that fixes are evidenced and checked for effectiveness.

*Status: Partial*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given In progress with completion evidence, when submitted, then the action is Pending verification.
- Given Pending verification and a verification note, when closed, then who verified and when are recorded.

**Routes:** `/actions` · **Capabilities:** CAP-041 · **Tests:** none yet

Known gaps:

- No tests for the corrective-action model or screen.
- Actions cannot be cancelled from the UI.
- Separation of duties is advisory text only.

## E12 — Accounts, workspaces and Cloud persistence

Acceptance criteria:

- Given sign-up, when completed, then I am asked to confirm by e-mail; password reset sends a link to /reset-password.
- Given sign-in, when it succeeds, then the demo state is cleared and my saved workspace loads.

## E13 — Platform console

**Goal:** Run every Python platform capability in the browser as parity-tested TypeScript ports.

**Area:** Platform console · **Status:** Demo

### S13.1

**As an AI governance lead**, I want to use the VERITRAIL Agent with roles, approvals and an audit log, so that I can see governed AI assistance end to end.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given a sensitive action (tier change, exception, policy activation, evidence export, external send), when requested, then it waits for a human approval.
- Given an approver, when resolving their own request, then it is refused and the attempt is audited.
- Given the audit log, when verified, then the hash chain checks out.

**Routes:** `/platform/agent` · **Capabilities:** CAP-061 · **Tests:** `platform-agent.test.ts`, `platform-audit.test.ts`

Known gaps:

- Synthetic data only; approvals have no external effect.

### S13.2

**As an engineering / platform lead**, I want to evaluate prompts, responses and tool calls against a policy pack in any rollout mode, so that I can test policy-as-code before deployment.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given an event and policy, when evaluated, then the decision, reasons, matched rules, findings and redacted payload are shown and logged.
- Given REQUIRE_HUMAN_APPROVAL, when an approver approves, then the event is re-run once with that approval.

**Routes:** `/platform/policy-simulator` · **Capabilities:** CAP-062 · **Tests:** `platform-policy-engine.test.ts`

### S13.3

**As a consultant / advisor**, I want to rehearse a pilot end to end and download its outputs, so that I can show the full method on realistic data.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given the rehearsal, when run, then it registers systems, tiers them with approvals, finds gaps, drafts policies and produces an approval-gated evidence pack and an audit chain.

**Routes:** `/platform/pilot-rehearsal` · **Capabilities:** CAP-063 · **Tests:** `platform-pilot.test.ts`

### S13.4

**As a Chief Risk / Compliance Officer**, I want to estimate ROI with clearly labelled hypotheses, so that the business case is honest about what is unmeasured.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given inputs, when calculated, then each line item shows its formula, and effect sizes are marked hypotheses with conservative, base and optimistic scenarios.

**Routes:** `/platform/roi-calculator` · **Capabilities:** CAP-064 · **Tests:** `platform-misc-parity.test.ts`, `platform-samples.test.ts`

### S13.5

**As a consultant / advisor**, I want to browse and download the sample reports, so that buyers see real outputs.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given the default date, when generated, then the samples match the committed Python outputs exactly.

**Routes:** `/platform/samples` · **Capabilities:** CAP-065 · **Tests:** `platform-samples.test.ts`

### S13.6

**As an AI governance lead**, I want to run the content checks in the browser, so that governed content stays valid and free of prohibited claims.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given the bundled content, when checked, then each of the six steps passes or lists its failures.

**Routes:** `/platform/content-checks` · **Capabilities:** CAP-066 · **Tests:** `platform-content-checks.test.ts`

### S13.7

**As an engineering / platform lead**, I want to see every platform module, what it does, where it runs and the Python code it replaces, so that I can trust that the browser tools match the reference platform.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given the console index, when it loads, then each module shows its summary, whether it runs in the browser or on the server, and the Python files it replaces.
- Given a module name that does not exist, when opened, then the not-found page is shown.

**Routes:** `/platform` · **Capabilities:** CAP-060 · **Tests:** `app-routing.test.tsx`

## E14 — Administration and privacy-first analytics

**Goal:** Give administrators leads, submissions and the funnel, using cookieless analytics and membership-checked access.

**Area:** Administration and analytics · **Status:** Live

**Capabilities:** CAP-067 Admin console, CAP-068 Privacy-first analytics

### S14.1

**As a site administrator**, I want to review assessment leads and other form submissions, and download leads as CSV, so that sales can follow up.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given I am signed in but not in site_admins, when I open the console, then I see the grant needed, not the data.
- Given I am an admin, when the console loads, then every server read re-checks membership before using the service role.

**Routes:** `/platform/admin` · **Capabilities:** CAP-067 · **Tests:** `platform-misc-admin.test.tsx`

Known gaps:

- The server-side membership check is not unit-tested.

### S14.2

**As a site administrator**, I want to see the funnel from page view to report download, and CTA clicks, so that I know where visitors drop off.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control, when set, then no event is sent.
- Given an event, when sent, then only its name, path and sanitised props are stored — no cookies, IP or identifiers.
- Given a site call to action, when clicked, then a cta_click event names it (hero, header, menu and CTA blocks).

**Routes:** `/platform/admin` · **Capabilities:** CAP-067, CAP-068 · **Tests:** `platform-misc-parity.test.ts`

Known gaps:

- form_submit and tool_use are allow-listed but never emitted.

## E15 — Installable app, search and reading experience

**Goal:** Make the site an installable, offline-capable app that is easy to search and read.

**Area:** Installable app · **Status:** Live

**Capabilities:** CAP-005 Glossary, CAP-070 Installable app (PWA), CAP-071 Offline reading, CAP-072 Site-wide search, CAP-073 Glossary definitions in text, CAP-076 Workspace app shell

### S15.1

**As a prospective buyer**, I want to install VERITRAIL on my phone or desktop, so that I can open it in one tap.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given Chrome, Edge or Samsung Internet, when installable, then the install card (after two pages or 40 s) and header button open the browser's dialog.
- Given iPhone, iPad or Safari 17+ on Mac, when I choose "Show me how", then step-by-step instructions are shown.
- Given "Not now", when chosen, then the card stays away for 14 days.

**Capabilities:** CAP-070 · **Tests:** `pwa.test.ts`

### S15.2

**As a prospective buyer**, I want to read pages I have opened while offline, so that I can keep reading without a connection.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given a page I opened online, when offline, then it opens from the device; an unopened page shows the offline page with saved pages listed.
- Given sign-in pages, server functions or URLs with query strings, when requested, then they are never cached.
- Given a Lovable preview, iframe, development or localhost, when loaded, then no service worker registers.

**Capabilities:** CAP-071 · **Tests:** `pwa.test.ts`

### S15.3

**As a prospective buyer**, I want to search everything with one box, so that I can jump to any page, control, term, workspace screen or tool.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given ⌘K, Ctrl+K or "/", when pressed, then the search opens from any page.
- Given a control ID such as "is11", when searched, then that control is the first result.
- Given results, when shown, then they are grouped by kind in order of best match.

**Capabilities:** CAP-072 · **Tests:** `search.test.ts`

### S15.4

**As a prospective buyer**, I want plain-language definitions of governance terms, so that I can follow pages without prior knowledge.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given a glossary term in page text, when it is the first mention on the page, then it is underlined and shows its definition on hover, focus or tap.
- Given the glossary page, when filtered by text or topic, then matching terms are listed with related controls.

**Routes:** `/glossary` · **Capabilities:** CAP-005, CAP-073 · **Tests:** `site-reading.test.ts`, `search.test.ts`

### S15.5

**As an AI governance lead**, I want the workspace header to fit on one row on every device, so that actions do not overlap the page title.

*Status: Done*

Acceptance criteria:

- Given any width from 360 px, when the workspace loads, then the header controls stay on one row; on phones theme, export, search and install sit in a "More actions" menu.
- Given the smoke test, when run, then a header that wraps fails the build.

**Capabilities:** CAP-076 · **Tests:** none yet
